source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data was run across all 2,795 priced, addressless sold Savills legacy appearances in 2010, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018. 202 matches were retained only where the exact hammer price, completion 61-90 days after auction, exact locality or postcode district, tenure and property class aligned to one compatible transaction used by no other lot. All no-result, ambiguous, class-conflicting, shared-transaction and already-used-address candidates remain unchanged. Original Savills/PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
